products.what_it_changes: Seller: Fastway's strongest billet aluminium peg, designed for the 2023 KTM/Husqvarna/GasGas competition-model changes; patented camber adjustment, adjustable footbed with two stainless cleat sets, mud-shedding serrations, low profile.

products.caveats: No peg part numbers on the page. Model lists are the seller's ranges expanded to in-scope models; 2025+ not listed.

products.caveats: GasGas 2023 MC models fall under MSPPMX0089 per the seller list even though KTM/Husqvarna 2023 MX models take MSPPMX0090; confirm against the bike's peg mount. 2025+ not listed.
